title: 六个衰老时钟一致：药物让人年轻3-6岁，安慰剂无效，下一步会是什么？
speaker: Alex Zhavoronkov

segments.en: we built our own algorithm which predicts your biological age. So you have two ages.
segments.zh: 我们构建了自己的算法，可以预测你的生物年龄。所以你有两个年龄。

segments.en: One is your chronological age, the age in your passport, and your biological age, which kind of defines when you're likely to die.
segments.zh: 一个是你的实际年龄，也就是护照上的年龄；另一个是生物年龄，它大致决定了你可能的寿命。

segments.en: And also is correlated with many other biological processes and physiological processes. So we used our own what we call aging clock
segments.zh: 同时，生物年龄还与许多其他生物和生理过程相关。因此，我们使用了自研的“衰老时钟”。

segments.en: and also five other independently developed proteomic aging clocks from frontier labs at Harvard, Beijing University at University of Connecticut.
segments.zh: 以及来自哈佛、北京大学、康涅狄格大学等前沿实验室的五个独立开发的蛋白质组衰老时钟。

segments.en: So around the world, scientists have published and developed those biomarkers of aging that now allow us to basically instead of waiting for patients to die
segments.zh: 全球科学家已发表并开发了这些衰老生物标志物，让我们不必再等待患者离世。

segments.en: and see how long did we add to their lifespan because that could be a very long time. You can now conduct clinical trials using aging clocks
segments.zh: 来观察我们延长了多少寿命，因为那可能需要很长时间。现在，你可以利用衰老时钟进行临床试验。

segments.en: and get some sense of direction, whether your drug is reversing biological age or not. And in this study, all of six clocks, one of ours
segments.zh: 从而判断你的药物是否逆转了生物年龄。在这项研究中，所有六个时钟——包括我们自己的一个

segments.en: and five independently developed ones, agreed that the drug has reversed biological age anywhere from three to six years, which
segments.zh: 以及五个独立开发的时钟——都一致认为该药物将生物年龄逆转了3到6年，这是一个

segments.en: is a very considerable number considering that the placebo, the patients that were not on the drug, they have not seen an effect.
segments.zh: 相当可观的数字，因为对照组（未服用该药物的患者）没有看到效果。

segments.en: So now it gives us very promising signal that the drug is working in aging.
segments.zh: 这给了我们非常有希望的信号，表明该药物在抗衰老方面有效。
